summary: Verified compile-error fix in BookingModal.jsx and re-tested full booking flow end-to-end via the deployed frontend URL. App compiles cleanly, home loads, booking modal opens (no console errors), the multi-step booking flow (services -> stylist -> date/time -> details -> confirm) completes successfully with POST /api/booking returning 200 and the confirmation screen showing the WhatsApp button. Bridal section still renders and adding a bridal package opens the booking modal. Also fixed a leftover Radix a11y warning by adding a sr-only <DialogDescription> in BookingModal (import existed but component was not rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The Radix DialogDescription was imported in BookingModal.jsx but not rendered, which caused a persistent console warning ('Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'). Fixed by adding a sr-only <DialogDescription>.
Nit: BookingModal.jsx is ~315 lines with services picker + stylist + calendar + details + confirm all inline; still readable but could be split into per-step subcomponents for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: BookingModal detail inputs use data-testids: input-full-name, input-phone, input-email, input-state, input-city, input-notes. Stylist buttons: stylist-<Name>. Time slots: slot-<HH:MM>. Calendar is shadcn react-day-picker (no data-testid on day cells; use button[name=day] and click next-month arrow first because today (2026-07-31) is the last day of the calendar page, all July days are disabled). Nav 'Book Now' testid is navbar-book-btn; hero is hero-book-btn. To exercise the flow, first add a service by clicking any [data-testid^='add-service-btn-'] on Home, THEN open the modal (modal step 0 is empty otherwise and requires 'pick from here').
rca of the issue: Iteration_3 was 100% green. A subsequent search_replace for a11y (adding sr-only DialogTitle) partially executed and left orphan JSX after 'export default BookingModal;' which broke the webpack/babel build. Main agent cleaned the file so 'export default BookingModal;' is the last statement. Verified: file now ends cleanly at line 314 and frontend supervisor logs show no compile errors. Additionally, DialogDescription was imported but never used, causing a Radix a11y console warning; added a sr-only DialogDescription to fully resolve.
